title: etbb-july-2024-may-2025-update.pdf — section 8
text:
6. The Lady Chief Justice and Senior President of Tribunals’ Equality and Diversity Statement
recognises that the principles of fair treatment and equality are fundamental to the judicial
role and apply both in and outside the court or tribunal. Judges will also want to refer to the
“Statement of Expected Behaviour” (January 2023), which reminds judges of the need to
treat others fairly and respectfully, including staff and other judges, and to ensure no one is
exposed to bias or prejudice. By their very nature, however, these documents provide only
generic guidance. The following paragraphs deal briefly with issues that arise daily in the
court or tribunal.
Good communication

7. Effective communication underlies the entire legal process, ensuring that everyone involved
understands and is understood. Otherwise, the legal process will be impeded or derailed.
